Mercedes-Benz of Palm Springs is delighted to showcase this Pre-Owned 2023 Toyota Tundra 1794 Edition, dressed in a striking Midnight Black Metallic exterior with a luxurious Saddle Tan Leather interior and with just 29,590 miles to its name. This premium full-size truck is a testament to Toyotas commitment to durability, capability, and refined comfort.

The 2023 Toyota Tundra 1794 Edition stands as a bold expression of modern truck design, combining rugged strength with upscale appointments. Its commanding presence is enhanced by 20-inch machined-finish alloy wheels, a distinctive chrome-accented mesh grille, premium LED lighting, and elegant 1794 Edition exterior accents. Equipped with Power Running Boards, a 5.5-foot short bed, and advanced towing technologies, this Tundra is engineered to perform whether on the job site or on a weekend adventure.


Step inside and the Saddle Tan Leather cabin welcomes you with a sophisticated blend of luxury and functionality. Premium features include heated and ventilated front and rear seats, a heated leather-wrapped steering wheel, driver memory seating, authentic American walnut wood-grain trim, and a panoramic roof. The advanced 14-inch Toyota Audio Multimedia touchscreen with JBL premium audio, wireless Apple CarPlay® and Android Auto™, along with a 12.3-inch digital instrument cluster, ensure every drive is connected and enjoyable.

Engine and Performance: At the heart of this exceptional truck is Toyota's i-FORCE 3.4-liter Twin-Turbocharged V6 engine, producing an impressive 389 horsepower and 479 lb-ft of torque. Power is delivered through a sophisticated 10-speed electronically controlled automatic transmission, providing smooth acceleration, confident towing capability, and outstanding efficiency. Multiple drive modes including Eco, Normal, Sport, and Tow/Haul allow this Tundra to adapt seamlessly to any driving situation.

Key Features:

• 1794 Edition Package: Premium Western-inspired luxury with exclusive interior appointments, authentic wood trim, and distinctive styling.

• Panoramic View Monitor: Provides a comprehensive view around the vehicle for enhanced confidence when maneuvering and parking.

• Toyota Safety Sense™ 2.5: Includes Pre-Collision System with Pedestrian Detection, Dynamic Radar Cruise Control, Lane Tracing Assist, and more advanced safety technologies.

• Heated and Ventilated Front and Rear Seats: Ensures exceptional comfort for all passengers regardless of the season.

• 14-Inch Toyota Audio Multimedia System: Featuring JBL® premium audio, wireless smartphone integration, and intuitive controls.

This 2023 Toyota Tundra 1794 Edition is far more than just a truck, it is the embodiment of Toyotas dedication to advanced engineering, premium craftsmanship, and dependable performance. Available at Mercedes-Benz of Palm Springs, this exceptional vehicle offers an opportunity to experience a refined full-size pickup that excels in capability, comfort, and style.

2025 Chevrolet Silverado 1500 RST 4WD | 3.0L Duramax Diesel | 305HP | Z71 Off-Road | 10,410 Miles |
Here's a rare combination that serious truck buyers search hard to find — a 2025 Chevrolet Silverado 1500 RST 4WD Crew Cab in Blackout with a Black interior, equipped with the 3.0L Duramax Turbo-Diesel I6 engine AND the Z71 Off-Road Package, with only 10,410 miles. Diesel efficiency meets genuine off-road capability in a blacked-out RST package that looks as aggressive as it performs. Call Victory Automotive Group for current pricing.
3.0L Duramax Diesel — Efficiency Champion
The Silverado RST's 3.0L Duramax Turbo-Diesel I6 produces 305 horsepower and a massive 495 lb-ft of torque from just 2,750 RPM, paired with an 8-Speed Automatic Transmission. The result is a truck that hauls and tows effortlessly while achieving an outstanding 22 city / 25 highway MPG — the best fuel economy of any full-size 4WD pickup in its class. With a maximum trailering capacity of 13,200 lbs, integrated trailer brake controller, Hitch Guidance, 7,000-lb GVWR, 220-amp alternator, and engine block heater for cold Kansas starts, this diesel Silverado delivers working truck credentials with commuter car efficiency.
Z71 Off-Road & Protection Package
This RST was ordered with the complete Z71 Off-Road Package giving it serious trail hardware including off-road suspension, skid plates, heavy-duty air filter, 2-speed electronic Autotrac transfer case, front frame-mounted black recovery hooks, Hill Descent Control, high-capacity suspension, and 265/65R18 tires on 18" bright silver painted aluminum wheels — all complemented by the Chevytec spray-on black bedliner, rear wheelhouse liners, all-weather floor liners, and Multi-Flex tailgate from the Protection Package. The High Gloss Black mirror caps, Black Bowtie emblem, body-color bumpers, and 20" High Gloss Black painted aluminum wheels give the RST an unmistakably aggressive blacked-out presence.
RST Interior & Technology
The cabin delivers genuine everyday comfort with a 10-way power driver's seat with lumbar, heated front seats, heated steering wheel, dual-zone automatic climate control, remote vehicle starter, keyless open and start, 40/20/40 front split-bench seat, rear 60/40 folding bench, 120V interior and bed-mounted power outlets, dual rear USB charge ports, 12.3" multicolor reconfigurable digital driver display, and Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Premium System with Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, SiriusXM with 360L, navigation, 6-speaker audio, and 4G LTE Wi-Fi Hotspot.
Chevy Safety Assist
Standard Automatic Emergency Braking, Forward Collision Alert, Lane Keep Assist with Lane Departure Warning, Front Pedestrian Braking, Following Distance Indicator, IntelliBeam automatic high beams, HD rear vision backup camera, StabiliTrak with Proactive Roll Avoidance, electronic trailer sway control, hill start assist, 4-wheel ABS disc brakes, Teen Driver mode, and Buckle to Drive deliver comprehensive active safety for every drive.
